Application Data.NAME: Mountain Peaks Outdoor Gear
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: CONTACT FOR INSPECTION": "John Smith, Store Manager
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Mountain Peaks Outdoor Gear operates a retail store specializing in camping and outdoor equipment, offering a wide range of products including tents, backpacks, sleeping bags, hiking apparel, and other outdoor gear. The store is located in a secure area with a monitored alarm system, features robust surveillance cameras, and employs loss prevention measures to deter theft. The premises are well-maintained, with regular inspections to prevent slip-and-fall hazards, ensuring safety for customers. The business does not engage in equipment rentals or offer any high-risk activities that could lead to liability claims, focusing solely on retail sales of outdoor equipment and accessories.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a theft incident occurred at the store where several high-value tents and backpacks worth approximately $5,000 were stolen. The loss was reported to the authorities and a claim was filed with the insurance company. The current status of the claim is pending, as the investigation is ongoing. Underwriting Guidelines:
Example: A golf store that sells clubs, balls, and apparel, operates from a secure location with
a monitored alarm system, and does not rent equipment or sell firearms would be classified as
Preferred. Conversely, a sporting goods store that rents out golf carts or firearms would be Not
Acceptable due to the increased operational risks.
Key Risk Considerations
When underwriting Golf & Sporting Equipment Stores, the following
risk factors require careful evaluation:
• Inventory Theft: Sporting goods, especially high-value items like golf clubs and branded
apparel, are frequent targets for theft. Stores should have robust loss prevention measures,
including surveillance cameras and secure display cases.
• Slip-and-Fall Liability: Retail premises must be well-maintained to prevent customer in-
juries. Wet floors, cluttered aisles, or uneven surfaces can lead to costly liability claims.
